title: Claude just airdropped a productivity pack for finance #shorts
description:
Claude just dropped 10 new AI agents for financial services.

If you use Excel, Powerpoint, work in banking or anything Finance related, this is a massive deal.

Here is the list of the 10 new agents.

There’s the Model builder…which can create financial models automatically from any data.

The Earnings reviewer… which can automatically read earnings call transcripts and will just update stock projections for you.

But my personal favorite is the Month-end closer…which will pretty much do all your month end accounting work automatically.

You can use these as plugins directly in Claude Code or Cowork…or run them as Managed Agents on your own.

Now, there’s a lot of doomsdaying & fearmongering about how this is the end for people in Finance.

And I just don’t think that’s the case.

Bankers work 80 hours per week.

Now, they can work 40 hours per week. Seems pretty great.

More efficient bankers, means more efficient deals, lower cost for deals, more deals, and a healthier finance ecosystem.

The real interesting part about this is how these plugins or bundles of AI skills, are the new AI versions of apps.

Just like Apple gives you the Photos app and the Clock app.

Claude essentially airdropped the most insane productivity upgrade to all financial services workers overnight.

If you’re in finance, or you know someone who is, get on these tools as soon as possible.

The people that know them best are the ones that will do the best.

Comment “Finance” I’ll send you the link so that you can download these directly.
